title: An optimal order fractional backward collocation method for adjoint Volterra integro-differential equations
summary: This paper develops and analyzes an optimal-order fractional backward collocation method for adjoint Volterra integro-differential equations with weakly singular kernels. The backward Volterra structure, together with the weakly singular kernel, induces fractional-power singularities at the terminal endpoint, thereby reducing the classical regularity of the exact solution and causing order deterioration in standard polynomial collocation methods.
